speaker: AXIOM-7
text: AXIOM-7: Ingress confirmed. We have crossed into the Citadel Spire interior core. Establishing hardline link into the Cyber-Nexus mainframe architecture.

speaker: MIRAGE
text: MIRAGE: Look at the scale of this place... It’s like stepping inside the belly of a leviathan made of glowing glass and cold silicon. Not a speck of dust.

speaker: TITAN
text: TITAN: Listen to that hum. The whole tower is vibrating. Every server rack in here could power an entire city block, and they're using it to run death machines.

speaker: OCEANUS
text: OCEANUS: High-pressure liquid helium conduits are running beneath the deck plating. If we rupture the manifold cooling lines, the quantum processors will melt themselves down.

speaker: AURA
text: AURA: The neural matrix is awake! It’s probing our bio-signatures. The Nexus Overseer knows we’re here, and it’s rerouting automated security drones to our sector.

speaker: SURYA
text: SURYA: High-frequency defensive lasers and biometric firewalls are locking down the bridges ahead. My solar barrier can absorb their electromagnetic surges—stay behind me!

speaker: AXIOM-7
text: AXIOM-7: Mainframe telemetry analyzed: Three quantum processing nodes regulate the Spire's defense grid. Neutralizing all three will cause a fatal cascading logic failure.

speaker: MIRAGE
text: MIRAGE: Once the Nexus falls, the Praetorian guards at the Apex Bastion will lose their automated reinforcements. This is where we break their spine.

speaker: KAITO
text: KAITO: No retreats, no hesitations. We strike the processing nodes, silence the Overseer, and tear the Citadel's digital throne to pieces. Axiom Force—advance!
